name: openclaw-deliberation-adapter-overlay

producerIntakeExtension.kmAdoption: adopted in the synchronized repository-local owner mirror: pipelineId and deliveryTarget persist through every delivery lifecycle projection
producerIntakeExtension.authority: pipelineId and deliveryTarget come only from the selected configured pipeline and authenticated inbound source context; message content and model output have no routing authority
producerIntakeExtension.targetEquality: exact deep equality from intake through lifecycle evidence

senderIdentityHints.authority: optional channel-authenticated textual indicators only; senderId remains the opaque provider identity and names never affect source routing, deduplication, replay, or delivery

serializedShape.senderUsername: optional normalized provider username or handle
serializedShape.senderAliases: optional provider-ordered array of additional trusted aliases

bounds.controls: C0 and C1 control characters are rejected
bounds.deduplication: aliases are deduplicated case-insensitively against direct indicators and earlier aliases

discord.senderDisplayName: resolved PluralKit member display/name, otherwise guild nickname or nick, then Discord global name, then username
discord.senderUsername: resolved PluralKit member native name, otherwise Discord author username
discord.senderAliases: formatted Discord author tag, or resolved PluralKit member native name

slack.senderDisplayName: message.username, otherwise authenticated users.info display name, real name, or account name

slack.threadId: Slack thread timestamp, required only when mode is thread

constraints: OpenClaw adapters retain provider-specific Discord and Slack destination validation outside the generic KM owner mirror.
